answer: Price each identity on a scarce external hardware anchor no clone can mint in bulk, then let standing deepen only when several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work-receipts, each endorsement soaking in like pigment into cloth: permanent, non-transferable. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one funding root, so its co-signs all trace back to a single knoll and never reach distinct anchors; honest trust scatters like yarrow from many real roots. The farm pays a distinct cross-cluster anchor per head (linear), honest pays once.
